scenes.story_beat: The young man stares intensely at his own reflection in the warm amber glow of a bathroom vanity against a dark midnight blue wall with resolute determination.
The man scrolls his thumb rapidly across a glowing smartphone screen in a dark bedroom illuminated by flickering blue light while slumped against a velvet headboard with vacant fixation.
A digital 'Still Watching?' notification illuminates the smartphone screen casting a harsh white glare onto the man's exhausted face on a messy pillow with stinging guilt.
The man slowly places the glowing smartphone face-down on a wooden nightstand as amber tungsten light catches floating dust in the dark room with profound exhaustion.
